rules.title: Security Deposit Limits and Requirements under Berkeley Rent Ordinance and State Law
rules.requirement: Starting July 1, 2024, landlords may charge only one month's rent for security deposits on unfurnished and furnished units, except landlords owning two rental properties with no more than four units total may charge up to two months' rent. Landlords must photograph the unit at or before tenancy start from July 1, 2025. Security deposits must be returned within 21 days after vacancy with an itemized statement of deductions and proof of repairs starting January 1, 2025. Landlords must pay interest on security deposits annually.
rules.summary_plain: From July 1, 2024, your landlord can only charge you one month's rent as a security deposit unless they own very few units, in which case they can charge up to two months. They must take photos of your unit at the start of your tenancy from July 1, 2025. When you move out, your landlord has 21 days to return your deposit with a detailed list of any deductions and proof of repairs. They also must pay you interest on your deposit each year.
rules.summary_plain_es: A partir del 1 de julio de 2024, su arrendador solo puede cobrar un mes de renta como depósito de seguridad, a menos que posea muy pocas unidades, en cuyo caso puede cobrar hasta dos meses. Deben tomar fotos de su unidad al inicio del arrendamiento a partir del 1 de julio de 2025. Cuando se mude, su arrendador tiene 21 días para devolver su depósito con una lista detallada de deducciones y prueba de reparaciones. También deben pagarle intereses sobre su depósito cada año.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to rental units covered by Berkeley Rent Ordinance and state law; small landlord exception applies to owners of two rental properties with no more than four units total owned by natural persons, family trusts, or LLCs with all natural persons.
rules.exemptions_text: Landlords owning only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total may charge up to two months' rent for security deposits if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC where all members are natural persons.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Board, Security Deposits webpage, Assembly Bill 12
rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units. Starting July 1, 2024, landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent for furnished and unfurnished units if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or limited liability company (LLC) where all members are natural persons.
